mentions.name: X/D Loom
mentions.description: This is a tool that helps car enthusiasts create automotive wiring loom diagrams. Users drag different electrical components onto a canvas, connect them with wires, and export the finished diagram to PDF or PNG.
mentions.problem: Searching for ways to create automotive wiring diagrams turned up only complex enterprise-grade solutions charging $200/month, and the author had previously left wiring changes from an engine swap and accessory installs undocumented, making the wiring hard to remember later.
mentions.audience: Car enthusiasts and project car builders creating custom wiring looms
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m developing X/D Loom (https://xdloom.com), a tool that helps car enthusiasts create automotive wiring diagrams.
